Sam/Priya —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier. Per our discussion, we want to run a focused 30-minute walkthrough with SE and your engineering team to validate integration surface area (VPC connectivity, prefix caching behavior, and auth/token lifecycle). Ben (SE) will lead the demo; Tessa from Solutions Adoption will help capture requirements.

Proposed windows (ET):
- Tue 2026-08-31 11:00–11:30
- Tue 2026-08-31 15:00–15:30
- Wed 2026-09-01 10:00–10:30

Agenda (draft):
- 5m intros & goals
- 15m SE live walkthrough (auth, KV cache, routing policy)
- 8m customer Q&A (networking, logs, retention)
- 2m next steps / action items

Attached: Redwood-SE-Agenda-30min.docx

If any of those times work, I’ll lock it and route a calendar invite. If procurement/security need to join, please loop them in — we can add a separate pre-demo security touchpoint if required.

Thanks —

Subject: Re: Proposed SE walkthrough + engineer Q&A (30m)

Hi team —

We can’t join the demo but need the security checklist responses in advance. Please provide:
- high-level data flow diagram (in/out of our VPC)
- retention defaults for request logs and KV cache
- whether any customer-controlled keys can be used (KMS/HSM support)

If Redwood can reply before EOD Monday (8/30), we’ll be able to sign off for attendance. We’ve attached a short template for your convenience — please populate and return.

Thanks,
Clara Nguyen
Security Engineer — Clearsight
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Clearsight Security <security@clearsight.io>, Sam Green <sam.green@clearsight.io>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T21:22:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Proposed SE walkthrough + engineer Q&A (30m)

Thanks Clara — attaching our answers (Clearsight-Security-Checklist-answers.pdf) and a short data flow sketch in the doc. High level answers inline: 
- Data flow: traffic goes from Clearsight -> customer gateway -> Redwood Private endpoint (no tokens persist on disk).
- Retention: request logs retained 30 days by default; can be configured to 7/90/365 per contract.
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM integrations on Private deployments.

One scheduling note: I’m booked Tue 8/31 15:00–16:00 for a standing ops sprint. I can still do 15:00–15:30 if we start promptly but Tessa/Aditya — can one of you cover the first 2–3 minutes of intros so I can jump straight into the demo? Alternatively, we can move the slot to 11:00–11:30 which I have free.

Attached: Clearsight-Security-Checklist-answers.pdf

Regards,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>

Ben/Aditya —

I’ll send the calendar invite (including the cleared security checklist) and add Raj + Priya as required attendees. Aditya — can you update the HubSpot deal with the confirmed demo time and attach the security PDF (HS-Contact-123456)?

Next steps:
- Tessa to send invite + attach checklist (within 30m)

- Clearsight to confirm final attendee list in the invite

Thanks — looking forward to it.
